info.name: Nguyen - API order lifecycle and stock reservation
info.description: Gateway-only API tests. Seeded by run.mjs. TC-NG-16 is sequential contention; TC-NG-25 sends concurrent confirmations. TC-NG-26 checks tenant-scoped codes. BR-05 configurable format has no public configuration contract yet.

item.name: TC-NG-16 first claimant takes last ten

exec: pm.test('One concurrent reservation succeeds, one is refused',()=>pm.expect(results.map(x=>x.status).sort()).to.eql([200,409]));
